name: LightGBM
champion_rationale: LightGBM won the Model Arena with the highest composite business score (0.8259), achieving test ROC-AUC of 0.9442, Recall of 0.9727, and PR-AUC of 0.9188. With threshold optimization at 0.15, it reduced hotel revenue loss from unpredicted cancellations to $175,415.00.
